faqs.q: Why does my Bloomfield roof leak only during wind-driven rain and not during normal rainfall?

runs.v: Wind-driven rain pushes water sideways under shingle edges and through flashing laps, so the leak traces to lifted shingles, short flashing overlaps, or failed step-flashing sealant; Newark Quality Roofing reproduces it with controlled directional water testing.

faqs.q: Can you find a leak on my Bloomfield home when the stain is far from any roof feature?

runs.v: Yes. On multi-plane Colonials and split-levels, water enters at an upper valley or flashing and travels along rafters and joists, so Newark Quality Roofing traces the path from the stain back to the actual entry point.
